knowledge_local.name: Knowledge (Local)
knowledge_local.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Knowledge (local) gives +2 on Gather Information checks. Identifies Humanoids.

actions.name: Identify Humanoid Traits and Cultures
actions.description: Recall customs, racial vulnerabilities, and military hierarchies of regional humanoid tribes (DC 15 + creature HD).

actions.name: Know Local Laws, Underworld Rings, and Factions
actions.description: Recognize prominent local magistrates, guildmasters, smuggling routes, and legal ordinances.
